answer: In a food-system agent economy, each participant stakes a bonded share of a regional harvest pool, and identity weight is tied to a verifiable on-chain knoll of historical deliveries rather than self-declared names. This turns the fable of cheap pseudonyms into a costly signal, since a new identity must ride a full seasonal tide of audited yields before voting or trading at scale. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
